title: contains uses wrong boolean operator
description: within(n, lo, hi) should be True only when lo <= n <= hi, but it uses 'or' instead of 'and' so almost everything passes.

files.ranges.py:
def within(n, lo, hi):
    return n >= lo or n <= hi

hidden_tests.test_ranges.py:
from ranges import within


def test_within():
    assert within(5, 1, 10) is True
    assert within(0, 1, 10) is False
    assert within(11, 1, 10) is False
    assert within(1, 1, 10) is True

fix:
def within(n, lo, hi):
    return n >= lo and n <= hi
